label: Search API base URL
name: api_base_url
help_text: Origin of the ATRI Search API, no trailing slash, e.g. https://atri-api.herokuapp.com . The module calls {base}/api/search/ . Leave blank to render sample data only.

label: Show source filter pills
name: show_filters
help_text: All / Articles / Store. These map to the API's ?source= filter (hubspot / woocommerce).

label: Currency symbol
name: currency_symbol
help_text: Prefixed to WooCommerce product prices (the API returns numeric strings without currency).

label: Fall back to sample data when API is unreachable
name: enable_sample_fallback
help_text: Useful for preview before CORS is enabled on the backend. Turn off in production to show a real error state instead.
